data.etymology: Madadgar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madadgar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مدادگار
in_arabic.long_meaning: مدادگار نام کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو دوسروں کی مدد کرتا ہے، সাহায্যকار، معاون۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'مدد' اور 'گار' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مدد کرنے والا۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کو دیا جاتا ہے جو اپنے مجتمع کے لیے مددگار ثابت ہوتے ہیں۔

in_urdu.name: مدادگار
in_urdu.meaning: مدد کرنے والا، ہمدرد، معاون شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: مدادگار کا نام اردو زبان میں مدد کرنے والے کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی 'مدد' جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں مدد یا سپورٹ۔ اس نام کا انتخاب ان بچوں کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنی بہبودی اور سماجی خدمات کے ذریعے دوسروں کی مدد کرنے کی صلاحیت رکھتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मददगार
in_hindi.long_meaning: मददगार नाम का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो दूसरों की मदद करता है, सहायक, मित्र। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'मदद' और 'गार' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मदद करने वाला। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों को दिया जाता है जो अपने समुदाय के लिए मददगार साबित होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: مددګار
in_pashto.long_meaning: مددګار نوم معنی دے هغه څوک چې نورو ته مرسته کوي، مرستیال، معاون. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه 'مدد' او 'ګار' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې مرستې کوونکی دی. په اسلامي کلتور کې، دا نوم هغو کسانو ته ورکړل شوی دی چې د خپل ټولنې لپاره ګټور دي.

in_english.name: Madadgar
in_english.long_meaning: Madadgar is an Islamic name that means 'helper' or 'supporter'. It is derived from the Arabic roots 'madad', meaning 'help' or 'support', and 'gar', meaning 'one who does' or 'agent'. This name signifies a person who provides aid and assistance to others. In Islamic tradition, it is given to individuals known for their benevolence and supportive nature.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Madadgar" in the Islamic culture is a title of respect given to individuals who have shown unwavering commitment and dedication to helping and supporting their community and fellow Muslims. This name reflects the importance of community solidarity, collaboration, and benevolence in Islam. Madadgar is a reminder of the significance of taking care of others, fostering good deeds, and providing assistance whenever and wherever possible.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the Islamic name "Madadgar" signifies the embodiment of selfless service and sacrifice in the Silat al-Rahman, or the love and kindness of Allah towards His creation. It serves as a reminder that we are all interconnected in the sight of Allah, and our actions and intentions towards others play a crucial role in the attainment of His pleasure. By living up to the name "Madadgar," individuals strive to embody the qualities of mercy, compassion, and generosity, thus drawing closer to Allah and fulfilling their spiritual obligations.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Helper" symbolizes One who helps and supports others, a benefactor. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Madadgar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of helper.
